_comment: The pinned set of KNOWN-failing crawler suites (DEBT plan item 2, cycle 184). Set-shrink-only: a failing suite NOT in this list is a NEW regression and fails the check; a listed suite that passes is banked by removing it here in the same commit. Baseline measured 2026-08-04 after batch 10: 17 suites / 49 tests; Crawler.test banked cycle 185 (26/26 after the c179 mock-path fix) leaving 16; c186 banked StagedGazetteerCoordinator.planner + OsmBoundaryIngestor (schema resolution fixed, both green) leaving 14; c188 banked runLegacyCommand (23/23 after MockNewsCrawler modernized to the event API) leaving 13; c189 banked configArgs (16/16 — the merge contract is deliberate, 2026-07-26 incident-backed; stale short-circuit test modernized + merge pin added) and sequenceContext (18/18 — adapter self-provisions from shared getDb, isolated cases now mock it null) leaving 11; c191 banked ProblemResolutionService (4/4 — ncdb retries the view per variant and normalizes hosts internally; white-box mock modernized to SQL-shaped, behavior-asserted) leaving 10; c191 banked both IntelligentPlanRunner suites (3/3 — the c181 extraction one-line dangler fixed; NewsCrawler loadable again) leaving 8 (was 51 until the placeHubs.data real-defect fix). Triage classes: phantom = cannot load (resolution fix first); env = needs missing dep/service; untriaged = not yet diagnosed. MEASURED c186 close: 14 suites / 50 tests — failing-test count ROSE as suites resolved (a suite that cannot load contributes zero test-failures; resurrection converts hidden brokenness into counted brokenness).
